text:
jess: Hey team — customer ACME-42 hit a 400 when calling /v1/tools/run with tool args pasted from a YAML file. They copied a multi-line YAML snippet into the 'args' text box in our dashboard (not wrapped as a JSON string) and our parser returns \"invalid JSON\". Repro steps + payload below. Happy to escalate if this is a known parser edge-case.

jess: Repro (console):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/run \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"tool":"yaml-convert","args": {
    name: ExampleApp
    version: 1.2
    env:
      - key: FEATURE_FLAG\\n      - key: TIMEOUT\\n  }}'
```

jess: Response we get: 400 Bad Request {"error":"invalid JSON at position 1", "request_id":"req_8f3c"} — looks like the server tried to parse the pasted block as JSON and choked on the YAML-style colons and unquoted keys.

sam_support: Thanks — can you paste the exact request_id and whether this was via the dashboard UI or via the API/SDK? Also which SDK version? If it was the UI, there have been previous issues where the args field does not auto-wrap pasted text.

jess: request_id=req_8f3c, customer used the dashboard -> pasted into the args box and clicked Run. SDK not involved. I tried repro-ing in curl and got the same error.

arun: tagging in eng. Quick note: our tool args parser expects a JSON object or a JSON-encoded string. It doesn't attempt to autodetect YAML. If a user pastes YAML literally into the args field, the backend receives invalid JSON (unquoted keys + newlines).

arun: Short term workaround: ask the customer to wrap YAML as a string, e.g. {\"args\": \"|\nname: ExampleApp\\nversion: 1.2\\n\"} or convert to JSON before sending.

arun: Long term we should consider adding client-side validation or a try-parse fallback to detect common YAML syntax and either reject with a clearer error or accept it after converting. I can open a ticket if we want a product fix.

sam_support: Can you add a minimal repro payload for engineering to run? Prefer a tiny curl that reproduces the exact failure (no extra fields).

arun: Minimal repro I used: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tools/run \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"yaml-convert","args": "name: app\\nversion: 1"}'
```
This fails because the value for args is still not valid JSON object if the server expects an object. If args is expected to be an object, the client must send a JSON object, not YAML.

deploy-bot: New issue created INC-3247: \"Dashboard: pasted YAML in tool args -> 400 invalid JSON\" assigned to eng oncall. See https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-3247 :eyes:

sam_support: Thanks all — I'm going to reply to the customer with the workaround (wrap as a JSON string or convert to JSON) and let them know we've created INC-3247 for product/eng to consider improving validation. If we want to auto-convert common YAML, please update INC-3247 with that ask.

jess: Confirmed customer accepted workaround and could run their job after converting YAML->JSON. Marking resolved for now but leaving INC open for UX improvement. :white_check_mark:
